name: gold-tracker
description: Central bank gold reserves by country, valued at the current gold price.

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.start: npm run build && npm start --prefix backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend

_enginesNote: The root scripts run the frontend test suite, which needs Vitest 5 (>=22.12) and jsdom 30 (>=22.22). The API itself runs on Node 20.6; see backend/package.json.
